title: Screw-on wall hook
about: a 70 mm coat hook printed on its side, with filleted corners and two countersunk teardrop screw holes
tries: Add a third screw hole at mid-height and check the countersink follows | Make a double hook with a second, shorter arm above the first

agent.role: a hardware designer who prints load-bearing hooks and brackets
agent.prompt: Prefer selecting edges by shape and by feature over listing them; keep the hook printed on its side; never put a screw hole where its countersink cuts into a fillet.

fragments.load: Estimate the load in newtons and keep the arm at least 8 mm thick for coats and bags.
fragments.screws: Size holes with j.hole.clearance and countersink them with a 45° chamfer of (head − bore) / 2.
